body:
Your ask: one cowboy and one cowgirl who ride round the horse trail now and then; 2 looks each to choose. Shown riding your kept horse.
- Cowboy Cody: brown hat, red checked shirt, yellow scarf, brown horse
- Cowboy Hank: black hat, denim shirt, leather vest, red scarf, black horse
- Cowgirl Daisy: tan hat, pink checked shirt, fringe vest, pigtails, cream horse
- Cowgirl Rose: white hat, turquoise shirt, suede vest, long hair, dark brown horse
Pick in Model Compare: Farm riding → Cowboy and Cowgirl (keep one look each, or both).

comments.text: Calmer riding pose (your note: the leg spread was extreme): hips close on the saddle, legs hang down the horse's sides at a small angle, knees a little forward. One rule for every rider, the horse card's Mounted look too. Viewer: 8/10.
Approved: you decided it in Model Compare (31 Oct).

source: chat 30 Oct: Living things models, round 34
title: Cowboy and cowgirl on the horse trail: 2 looks each
